ai.subject: Microbiology & immunology
ai.summary: Medical microbiology blends basic science with clinical practice, guiding diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of infectious diseases. It teaches clinicians to think in terms of causation, transmission, and host response rather than rote lists.

sections.p: Microbiology studies organisms that cause disease, their life cycles, and how they interact with hosts. Clinicians use this knowledge to identify pathogens, predict spread, and choose effective therapies.
Pathogens possess specific traits—cell wall composition, replication strategy, and immune evasion—that determine clinical presentation and treatment options.
